prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. New collectible for a cozy Korean mobile aquarium game. STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; do not draw the reference character or reference background. NOT a realistic scientific illustration, not fine anatomical realism. No otter ears/fur/accessories. Subject: A tiny plump peach-orange shrimp, bean-shaped chunky curved body, small white polka dots, BIG friendly glossy eyes, short thick walking legs, fine curved antennae and small tail fan; side view facing LEFT. A square 2x2 animation SPRITE SHEET, four equal square cells, exactly ONE same subject per cell, facing LEFT in all four cells. Four subtle leg and tail crawling phases. Same character size, body center and proportions in all frames. IMPORTANT: each full animal bounding box INCLUDING antennae, crown, coral branches, tail, fins must occupy NO MORE THAN 32% of TOTAL canvas width AND height (64% of its cell). Exact centers: 25%,25%;75%,25%;25%,75%;75%,75%. Broad blank transparent gaps: center vertical band x=43%..57% and horizontal y=43%..57% completely empty; outer 8% border blank. No zoom-in, no grid lines. Four SMALL subjects separated by ample blank space. Genuine ALPHA TRANSPARENT PNG, no checkerboard, black background, scene, rocks, floor, water, bubbles, cast shadow, text, labels, screen UI or watermark. Use thumbnail reference for EXACT animal identity and preserve its grade-specific rendering style.
